FLASHSCORE PREVIEW

Nice will seek an immediate return to Ligue 1’s top six when they host a Troyes side who could be on the up after escaping the relegation zone in the last round. 

Match News and Current Form

After enjoying three successive wins, Nice came unstuck against league leaders PSG last weekend, with 3-2 home defeat ending a nine-game unbeaten streak across all competitions at the Allianz Riviera (W4, D5). The pressure is on their defensive unit to improve after completing five matches as hosts without a clean sheet (W3, D1, L1), especially if they want to bounce back from starting this round in seventh place. Olivier Pantaloni’s side have shown the resilience to quickly put a bad result behind them, following up their last two Ligue 1 defeats with consecutive victories.

Troyes defeated last-placed Le Havre 3-1 at home in the last round to register their second win from their last three league games (L1), more than they had managed across their opening eight matches of the season (W1, D2, L5). Superpowers PSG are the only team to have defeated Stéphane Dumont’s side from round eight onwards and ESTAC have the opportunity to win consecutive top-flight games for the first time since August 2022. Their lasting inability to string together victories stems largely from poor performances on the road, demonstrated recently by having failed to score in each of their four Ligue 1 away fixtures since the end of August (D1, L3).

Head-to-Head History

Nice have won four of their last five Ligue 1 matches against Troyes (W4, L1), including the most recent three, whilst six of the last seven H2Hs have been decided by a single-goal margin.

Win Probability
Opta by StatsPerform
Hot Stats and Streaks

Nice have scored exactly two goals in six of their last seven Ligue 1 fixtures.

All of Nice’s last five home fixtures saw both teams score.

Troyes failed to score before half-time in four of their five away league games this season.

Troyes received exactly two bookings in four of their last five fixtures.

Key Players to Watch and Missing Players

Jonathan Clauss is in a rich vein of form with his two assists last weekend taking his tally to six goal contributions (G3, A3) from the last six matches. Antoine Mille is the only Troyes player to have assisted an away goal this season and he scored two of their three goals last weekend.

Elye Wahi could join Mohamed Abdelmonem on Nice’s injury list, while Troyes have no new availability issues.

For all the latest team news, please check the Flashscore match centre.

Betting Analysis

Considering Troyes’ ongoing inability to even score on the road let alone win, backing Nice to win with a clean sheet looks to be an intelligent approach.

Author: Tom Penn
